test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 18 Sept 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which of the following ministries introduced The Weapons of Mass Destruction and their Delivery Systems (Prohibition of Unlawful Activities) Amendment Bill, 2022, in the Lok Sabha on 5 April 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is **'Ministry of External Affairs'.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

 
• The Weapons of Mass Destruction and their Delivery Systems (Prohibition of Unlawful Activities) Amendment Bill, 2022 was introduced in Lok Sabha o**n April 5, 2022,** by **External Affairs Minister Dr. S Jaishankar.**
 
• The Bill **amends the Weapons of Mass Destruction and their Delivery Systems (Prohibition of Unlawful Activities) Act, 2005.**
 
• The Act 2005 **prohibits unlawful activities** (such as manufacturing, transport, or transfer) related to **weapons of mass destruction** and **their mean of delivery.**
 
• Weapons of mass destruction are **biological, chemical, or nuclear weapons.**
